gen-dafont-junegull-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada stands tall and full, with a steady line throughout. Its strength is the tension: Junegull pinches its curves shut while the sans lets every one stand open.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-readex-pro: Retro and friendly, Junegull holds its pinched curves shut while Readex Pro keeps broad gaps at every terminal. Closed letters up top, open ones below, and that is the whole charm.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-roboto: Retro charm first: Junegull's lowercase stands tall as cast iron. Junegull does best at making a statement with its pinched curves; Roboto does best at generous, open-mouthed round letters.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-ruda: Ruda draws a wire-like line with a sizable x-height. Junegull plants a retro, closed-curve heading up top, and Ruda's wide-mouthed sans-serif rounds open everything up right beneath it, friendly throughout.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-saira: Saira lets you see right through each s, and its rounded letters stretch high toward the top line. Pages of it would read clean and smooth beneath Junegull's thread of ink.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Junegull draws spaghetti-like, same-width strokes and pinches each curve almost shut. Schibsted Grotesk then keeps reading friendly, its big open e and a with tall bowls and terminals that never close in.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-sintony: Retro swagger first, as Junegull pinches every curve nearly shut. Sintony, a sans-serif with a chunky, tall midzone, does its best work staying smooth, with no clogged curves, while Junegull makes the statement.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-stack-sans-headli: Retro and friendly, Junegull stands tall as cast iron. Shrink Junegull small and those pinched curves would crowd, so let Stack Sans Headline, with wide gaps and a deep middle band, carry the small sizes.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-tiktok-sans: Retro and friendly, Junegull pinches every curve and stands tall as cast iron. TikTok Sans, its x-height rising close to cap height and its c generously open, leaves Junegull to earn its keep big and brief.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-vend-sans: Junegull wears a lowercase with cast-iron capital stature. Beside Vend Sans, a sans with a ruler-drawn line, wide unclosed terminals and a line-filling x-height, Junegull's pinched curves feel snug, retro and friendly.
